text: Illustrate the story here: The Mud Track Mack and Rick are at the mud track. The pals see lots of trucks. The big truck gets stuck in the mud. The small truck goes fast on the track. Mack and Rick clap. Mack goes to the snack stand to grab a pack of gum. At the snack stand, he sees his pals, Beck and Nick. Rick sees the pack at the snack stand and yells, "Get back, quick!". The pals run back to the track. A truck ran into a stack of bricks! The pack yells and jumps. "The mud track is the best," says Mack.
